top_signals.title: JPMorganChase Announces New Leadership for $1.5 Trillion Security and Resiliency Initiative
top_signals.summary: JPMorganChase has added two senior leaders to support shipbuilding and maritime efforts within its Security and Resiliency Initiative (SRI), the firm's $1.5 trillion, 10-year effort focused on strengthening industries critical to economic and national security.
